Modern.brandNameRationale: Apiary is the working-trade word for a managed bee yard. North names the climate posture — a brand from a cold-climate beekeeping tradition. Together: a modern apiary with a sharp geographic identity, away from the Mediterranean honey cliché.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern beekeeping has matured beyond the hobbyist forum. The opening is for a brand that names a real climate — cold-climate apiaries (Canada, Northern Europe, Scandinavia) produce distinct honey profiles and overwintering knowledge that the Mediterranean tradition does not.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Bee Maid Honey (beemaid.com) holds the Canadian co-op peer slot. Hilltop Honey (hilltop-honey.com) plays the UK modern peer. Savannah Bee Company (savannahbee.com) is the US craft reference. We sit alongside Bee Maid with a sharper cold-climate identity.
Modern.positioningStatement: A modern cold-climate apiary brand for honey buyers who care about overwintering and varietal source.

dos: Name the floral source and the harvest week

Modern.logoDirection: A wordmark only — Apiary North in a precise grotesk, with a small hexagonal cell as a hallmark, used at small scale on the jar lid.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for harvest data on the label
typography.rationale: One family. Mono for the harvest week, regular for the brand.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Propolis is the resinous compound bees use to seal the hive — historically the most prized hive product, used by Hippocrates and across European apothecary traditions. House of Propolis names a luxury wellness apothecary register where honey is one product among many hive medicaments.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury honey is dominated by manuka claims. The opening is for an apothecary-coded brand that positions hive products (honey, propolis, royal jelly, beeswax) in the wellness-medicament tradition, with documented sourcing.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Manuka Doctor (manukadoctor.com) holds the manuka-medicament peer slot. Comvita (comvita.com) plays the global premium peer. Steens Honey (steenshoney.com) is the New Zealand small-batch reference. We sit alongside Comvita with an apothecary-coded identity beyond manuka.
Luxury.positioningStatement: A luxury apothecary brand for hive products — honey, propolis, royal jelly — in the medicament tradition.

behaviors: Reads the propolis and royal jelly source on every bottle
Pays a premium for documented hive-product certification
Buys at considered apothecaries and pharmacies

dos: Cite the hive's floral source and certification

Luxury.logoDirection: A serif wordmark — House of Propolis set in a classical roman with a small embossed bee-and-hive crest. The crest appears on the apothecary jar lid.

typography.primary: Caslon for the wordmark and labels
typography.secondary: Adobe Garamond for the apothecary insert
typography.rationale: Caslon carries the apothecary heritage register. Garamond handles the long-form insert.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Skep is the single archaic English word for the woven straw hive used in European beekeeping before the Langstroth movable-frame design (1851). Single-syllable, trade-specific, instantly evocative. Minimal honey brand with a real beekeeping-vocabulary anchor.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal honey is rare in a category obsessed with provenance stories. The opening is for a brand named on a single piece of beekeeping vocabulary, with a plain jar and a single seasonal honey.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: London Honey Company (londonhoney.co.uk) holds the small-batch urban peer slot. Bermondsey Street Bees (bermondseystreetbees.co.uk) plays the minimal urban peer. The Hive Honey Shop (thehivehoneyshop.co.uk) is the trade-vocabulary peer. We sit further out — single word, single seasonal honey.
Minimal.positioningStatement: A minimal honey brand selling one seasonal honey from a single named apiary.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Apis is the genus name for the honey bee (Apis mellifera). The Latin binomial places the brand in the apicultural-science tradition. Group names the multi-line B2B operator — breeding stock, supply, queen rearing, contract pollination.
Corporate.industrySummary: Corporate apiculture is a serious B2B category — breeding stock, queen rearing, contract pollination for almond and orchard growers. The opening is for a mid-tier multi-service operator with documented breeding lines.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Olivarez Honey Bees (ohbees.com) holds the US queen-rearing peer slot. Mann Lake (mannlakeltd.com) plays the supply-distribution peer. Adee Honey Farms (adeehoney.com) is the contract-pollination reference. We sit alongside Olivarez with a sharper multi-line operator identity.
Corporate.positioningStatement: A corporate apiculture operator covering queen rearing, supply, and contract pollination.

targetAudience.primary: Almond and orchard growers, commercial beekeepers, and apicultural research institutions.

dos: Speak the language of orchard operators

Corporate.logoDirection: A wordmark — APIS in a tight engineering grotesk above GROUP in tracked small caps. A single hexagonal-cell mark appears on supply documents.

Creative.tagline: The hive and the tool, side by side.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Pairs the skep (the woven hive) with the smoker (the tool beekeepers use to calm a hive). Two trade-specific objects in conjunction — a creative-register honey and hive-products brand that names what's on the workbench.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative honey is crowded with rustic-trade-shop imagery. The opening is for a brand that takes the tools of the trade as its identity — the skep, the smoker, the hive tool — and treats them as the storytelling anchor.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Black Bee Honey (blackbeehoney.com) holds the storytelling craft peer slot. The London Honey Company (londonhoney.co.uk) plays the urban-craft peer. Bee Local (beelocal.com) is the Portland-craft reference. We sit alongside Black Bee with a sharper tools-of-the-trade identity.
Creative.positioningStatement: A creative beekeeping brand named on the tools — selling honey, beeswax, and small hive goods.
